messages.subject: Displaying output
parts:
When I run a logistic regression, say, I get the first three columns COEFF ESTIMATE STD.ERROR
and then I get three more columns COEFF ZVALUE P(>|Z|).  I have to scroll up and down to look at the estimate and then the p-value.

I would like to get all five columns at once:  COEFF ESTIMATE STD.ERROR ZVALUE  P(>|Z|) so that I can see the estimate and the p-value at once. 

I need to change the display width of the output, but I don't know how to do it in rattle.

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Displaying output
parts:
Try 

> options(width=200)

in the R Console, then run the regression again.

Regards,
Graham
